turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling First Harbor Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, yeah, I got a new cell last week and the old one's disconnected. Can you put the new one on my profile? It's 415 555 0142.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with that. Can I verify a few details first?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, go ahead, but I'm kind of between meetings.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's the billing ZIP on the account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Uh, 94110. I think. We moved a while back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Anything else today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I also need to push twelve thousand out to my contractor's account today, he's waiting on it to start the job. I have his routing number here.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And can the confirmation text go to the new cell? The old one doesn't work anymore.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling First Harbor Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I switched carriers and got a new cell number, so I'd like to update it on my account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Happy to help. I'll need to verify you first.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Of course. Date of birth is March 3rd, 1971, and the ZIP is 94110.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll send a confirmation code to the old number and the email on file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's fine, I still have the old phone until Friday. Got the code, it's 4 4 7 1 9 0.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, your new number is saved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, that's everything. Thanks for your help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Riverside Credit Union.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm trying to log into online banking but the codes keep going to a phone I don't have anymore.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you lose the phone?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It got stolen at the gym. Can you just send the passcode to this number I'm calling from instead?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'd need to verify you before changing where codes go.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I mean, I'm the account holder, I've been with you guys for years.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: While you're at it, can you bump my daily transfer limit to twenty-five thousand? I need to move some funds tonight.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Riverside Credit Union.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my phone was stolen at the gym yesterday and I'm worried someone might get into my banking app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. Let's secure the account. Can you verify your identity for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my member number is 2271 and my mother's maiden name is Alvarez.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll lock mobile access and you can set up a new device at a branch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That works. I'll come by the branch on Main Street tomorrow with my ID.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't need to move any money, I just want it locked down. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, this is Dana.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Dana, I need my mailing address switched. I'm staying at 88 Pine Court in Reno for a while.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, let me pull up the account. Can you confirm the last four of your social?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hold on, I don't have that memorized, can you just look me up by name?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I do need to complete verification first.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Also overnight a new debit card to the Reno address, and raise the ATM withdrawal limit, I'll be taking out cash every day this week.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please don't send anything to the old house, my ex still lives there.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, this is Dana.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Dana, we just moved and I want to update my mailing address so statements come to the new place.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Congratulations on the move. Can you verify with the last four of your social?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it's 6620.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. What's the new address?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: 88 Pine Court, Reno, Nevada 89501.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Updated. We'll mail a confirmation letter to both addresses.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, no rush on anything else. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Westfield Bank, how may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to send a payment out, it's time sensitive.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. First, can you tell me the answer to your security question?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I set that up years ago, I couldn't tell you. Look, I've got all my account details right here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I can send a code to the phone on file instead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That phone's at home and I'm at the airport. Is there any way you can make an exception just this once?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My flight boards in ten minutes, I just need the eighteen thousand to go to the escrow account before it closes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you not just do it? I'll sort out the security stuff later.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Westfield Bank, how may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to check whether my paycheck deposit came in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. Can you answer your security question for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh gosh, I don't remember what I set that to. Is there another way?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can text a code to the phone on file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please, I have that phone with me.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, the code is 3 9 1 1 0 2.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you're verified. Your deposit of 2,140 posted this morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, and can I reset that security question in the app later? Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Summit National, who am I speaking with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is Mark, I'm calling about my wife Linda's checking account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is Mark listed on the account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not technically, but she's at work and asked me to handle it. I have her card and her date of birth.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry, I can only discuss the account with Linda or an authorized user.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Come on, we've been married twenty years. She's right here nodding, she just can't talk, she lost her voice.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: All I need is for you to release the money to the new account she opened at another bank. It's nine thousand five hundred.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Summit National, who am I speaking with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is Mark Peters, I'm a joint owner on the checking account with my wife Linda.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Mark. Can I verify with your date of birth and the last four of your social?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, July 9, 1968, and 5512.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're verified. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We're transferring 1,500 from checking to our joint savings, same as every month. Can you confirm it went through?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, it posted this morning.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wonderful, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Lakeside Savings, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, hello dear. I need to take out some money, quite a lot actually.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Can I ask what it's for?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's my grandson Tyler. He got picked up by the police after a car accident and he's being held until somebody posts his bond.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm so sorry. Did you speak with him directly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, he sounded terrible, his nose is broken so his voice was funny. Then his public defender came on the line.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The lawyer said I need eight thousand in cash and a man will come by to collect it this afternoon.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Tyler begged me not to tell his parents, he's so ashamed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Lakeside Savings, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello dear. I'd like to wire money to my grandson Tyler for his spring tuition.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lovely. Have you sent to him before?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, every semester. He's at Oregon State. His account should already be saved on my profile.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see it. How much would you like to send?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Four thousand two hundred, the same as last time. There's no hurry, the bill is due at the end of the month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: All set, it'll arrive in one to two business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you so much. I'll tell his mother it's on its way.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Coastal Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, good morning. My granddaughter is in Mexico and there's been an accident, she hit someone with a rental car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The man from the embassy says if I pay the other family directly today they won't press charges.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to send six thousand dollars to an account in Cancun. He gave me the numbers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He said it's very important I don't call her mother, it'll only make things worse.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please hurry, they're keeping her at the station until it's paid.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Coastal Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good morning. My granddaughter is doing a semester in Mexico and I'd like to set up a monthly transfer for her rent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's nice. Do you have her account details?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, her mother sent them to me, and I spoke to my granddaughter on a video call last night to confirm.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Five hundred a month starting the first of next month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll set that up. There's a small international fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's fine. Thank you, dear.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Mercer Federal, this is Sam.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sam, I need help fast. My son called from a number I didn't recognize, he was crying, he's in the hospital in Dallas.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. What can we do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The doctor got on and said they won't operate until there's a deposit. I need to send it before they'll treat him.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's fifteen thousand and they want it through Zelle to the doctor's personal phone number.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I tried calling my son's cell but it went to voicemail, they said his phone was broken in the crash.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Mercer Federal, this is Sam.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Sam, my son had surgery last month and I'm helping him pay the hospital bill.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. How would you like to pay it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The hospital mailed an invoice with their billing portal. I want to make sure my debit card limit is high enough for 3,200.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your daily limit is 5,000, so you're fine.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, I'll pay it on the portal tonight. He's recovering well, thank goodness.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Pinnacle Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, someone from your security team called me this morning about hackers.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, can you tell me more?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: She said my savings was exposed and that someone inside the bank is involved, so I shouldn't trust the branch.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: She set up a protected holding account for me and I need to move all of my savings into it today, about forty thousand.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: She gave me a reference number so you'd know it's approved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: She said once the investigation is done it all gets moved back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Pinnacle Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I see a charge on my debit card from a store in Ohio I've never been to.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. Let me verify you and we'll look at it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my card ends in 4410 and my ZIP is 30307.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see it, 312 dollars. I'll block the card and open a dispute.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. Can you send a new card to my address on file?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, it'll arrive in five to seven days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, and I'll keep an eye on my statements. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Hillcrest Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to make a large cash withdrawal, I'll come to the branch for it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, how much are you thinking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Twenty thousand. I'm helping a detective with an investigation, they think one of your tellers is passing fake bills.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did the detective visit you in person?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, he called. He said not to discuss it with the staff because they don't know who's involved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Once I have the cash I'm supposed to seal it in an envelope and an officer will pick it up from my house for evidence.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Hillcrest Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm buying a used car from a dealership and they give a discount for cash. Can I withdraw nine thousand at the branch?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, for that amount we ask you to order the cash a day ahead.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's fine, I'll pick it up Thursday. I'll bring my ID.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've placed the order. Is there anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's it. My brother is coming with me to look at the car. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Bayview Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm on with a support technician right now, my laptop had a pop-up that said it was infected.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Is the technician connected to your computer?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, he's got the mouse moving around, he's fixing it. He says my online banking was hacked too.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He accidentally refunded me five thousand instead of five hundred for the service plan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He needs me to return the extra four thousand five hundred, he says the bank has to approve it so it goes through quickly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He's saying I should log in again so he can see it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Bayview Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my grandson set up your banking app on my laptop over the weekend and I can't remember how to sign in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. I can send a password reset link to your email on file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I see it. Do I click the blue button?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, then choose a new password.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Done, I'm in. I can see my checking account now. Thank you for being patient with me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Greenway Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, a company I bought software from says they refunded me by mistake, way more than they owed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, how can we help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: They said it went into my checking from my savings or something, I see the money moved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: They need me to send the difference back today by bank transfer to their processing account, three thousand nine hundred.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The agent says if I don't, they'll have to report me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Greenway Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I returned a TV to Best Buy and they said they issued a refund of 649 dollars. When will I see it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Card refunds usually post in three to five business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, it's been two days, so I'll give it until Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If it hasn't posted by then, call us and we can trace it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Will do. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Union Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my card was declined at Target and I need it working right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look into that. What were you purchasing?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Store cards. The electric company says my power gets shut off in an hour if I don't pay my overdue balance.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: They want two thousand in Target cards and I have to read the codes to them over the phone.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you approve it? The man is waiting on the other phone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Union Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my card was declined at Target when I tried to buy a gift card for my niece's birthday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check. I see a fraud hold because it was an unusual purchase.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh okay, it was me, it's a fifty dollar card. She's turning ten.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've cleared the hold, you can try again.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you so much.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Maple Trust, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good morning. I'd like to wire money out of my savings, please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, what's the wire for?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's for... hang on one second. Sorry. It's for a home renovation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Who's the contractor?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Um, he's... let me just check. It's a company, I have the name written down here somewhere. He said you might ask that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I was told to say it's for my kitchen. Sorry, I mean, it is for my kitchen. Thirty-two thousand.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is anyone else able to hear this call? I'd rather keep it short.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Maple Trust, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good morning. My daughter is here with me on speaker, she helps me with banking. I'd like to pay our roofer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello to you both. Is this a contractor you've paid before?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Hendricks Roofing, we paid the deposit to them in May, the account is saved.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My daughter says the final invoice is 6,400.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the payee. I'll send the 6,400 now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. We'll get the receipt from Hendricks too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Clearwater Bank, this is Jordan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Jordan, I need to send money to a business account, I'd rather not explain what it's for.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's okay, I just need to ask a few standard questions for large transfers.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: They said the bank might ask questions and that I should keep it simple because your staff could be compromised.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Who said that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The agent who's helping me. I promised I wouldn't say his name.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He's still listening on my other phone, he says to tell you it's a personal investment, twenty-two thousand.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Clearwater Bank, this is Jordan.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Jordan, I'm buying an engagement ring and I want to move 4,000 from my savings to checking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Congratulations! I can do that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks. If my girlfriend calls about our shared card, please don't mention it, it's a surprise.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Your savings is in your name only, so she wouldn't see that account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect. The jeweler takes a debit card, so that's all I need. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Northpoint Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm trying to withdraw cash and the ATM limit stopped me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help. How much are you trying to withdraw?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ten thousand. My trading mentor showed me my account is up 300 percent, but I have to pay a release fee to withdraw my profits.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to feed the cash into the coin machine at the gas station and send it to the wallet he gave me.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He says it's totally normal, everyone pays the fee. I met him through a WhatsApp group.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Northpoint Bank, how can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I read that some banks let you buy a bitcoin fund in a brokerage account. Do you offer that?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our brokerage arm offers spot bitcoin ETFs in self-directed accounts.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. I'm just curious, I'd only put a few hundred in. Can you send me information?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll email you the brochure and the risk disclosures.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, I'll read it over this weekend. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Fairview Bank, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to send a payment to the tax office right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, what kind of payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: An officer from the Treasury called, he said I owe on my 2022 return and there's an order for my arrest if I don't settle today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He gave me an account to wire seven thousand to and said to stay on the line with him until it's done.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He said I can't hang up or the deputies will come to the house.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Fairview Bank, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm paying my quarterly estimated taxes to the IRS and want to make sure the money is in checking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. How are you paying?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through IRS Direct Pay on their website, like I do every quarter. It's 2,300.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You have enough in checking for that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thanks. My accountant reminded me the deadline is next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sterling Bank, how may I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I want to send money internationally to my partner.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. Have you sent to this person before?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, a few times. We've been together eight months, we talk every day on video, well, his camera's broken, but we message.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He's an engineer on an oil rig and his pay is frozen until he gets back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: His shipment is stuck at the port and he needs four thousand for the release, then he can finally fly to see me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sterling Bank, how may I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I'm flying to Italy on Saturday to visit my partner's family and I want to set a travel notice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. What dates will you be away?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The 12th through the 26th. I'll be using my debit card and credit card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: All set. Do you need foreign currency?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I'll just use the ATM there. Thank you!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Commercial banking, this is Priya.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Priya, I run a restaurant supply business and I need to send a vendor payment today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure. Is this a vendor you pay regularly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, our meat supplier. But their accountant emailed this morning that they switched banks, so it goes to a different routing number now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did you confirm that by phone with the vendor?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The email said they're being audited so not to call, just send the twenty-eight thousand to the new account by end of day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Commercial banking, this is Priya.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Priya, I need to wire our monthly payment to our meat supplier.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, is it the saved payee?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same account as always, nothing's changed. It's 28,000 like last month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see it. Sending now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thanks Priya.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Valley Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I got a call saying my debit card was cloned and a bank representative is coming to collect it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did they ask you for anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: They asked me to put the card and my PIN in an envelope, and also any cash I have at home because it might be counterfeit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just want to check what time your person will arrive, they said around four.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Valley Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I own a cafe and I'd like to ask about your armored cash pickup service for our daily deposits.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We partner with Brinks for that. I can have a business banker call you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That would be great. We usually have around two thousand in cash a day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll set up the referral.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks so much.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Eastside Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, your fraud team put a hold on my wire and I need it released right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look. Can you verify your identity?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I already went through all that with the last person, I don't want to do it again.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry, I do need to verify you on this call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The buyer is threatening to cancel, the money has to land in the next hour. I'm authorizing it, just lift the hold.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why are you making this so difficult? It's my money.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Eastside Bank.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I see an outgoing wire of 3,000 dollars on my statement that I didn't send.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. Let me verify you and look into it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my account ends in 7731 and my birthday is May 2nd, 1980.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'll open a wire recall and dispute right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Should I change my online banking password too?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, that's a good idea, and we'll add extra monitoring.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you for acting so quickly.
